description: Creates a Dropbox upload link that saves into the matter folder, and returns the link. Does not email or text it. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

deadline.description: Optional ISO date or timestamp after which uploads close.

description.description: Instructions shown on the upload page.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result without a second write. Defaults to preview_id.

matter_id.description: Matter identifier from find_matter or list_open_matters.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

subpath.description: Existing folder, relative to the matter folder, for uploads. Omit for the matter root.

title.description: What the client sees on the upload page.

name: create_dropbox_file_request
title: Create client upload link
